title: UI Animation Polish, Manual Import Fixes & Standardized Confirm Modals
summary: Extensive frontend polish including interactive SVG tray/arrow directional hover animations, multi-format manual import parser fixes, standardized warning confirmation dialogs, and non-overlapping toast notice positioning.
changes: Sync Mode Grid & Icons: Redesigned the sync modal into a clean 2x2 grid layout featuring square grey action buttons for Send and Receive, and a full-width dashed Import zone with layered folder/document SVG vector icons.

Interactive Hover Animations: Separated SVG elements into independent tray and arrow components. On hover, Send and Receive arrows smoothly shift in their respective directions and hold position with a 0.15s unhover return delay. The import folder document slides up, tilts 12 degrees, and scales on hover.

Manual Account Import Fixes: Restored and reconnected manual account import functionality to seamlessly parse plaintext URIs (otpauth://), raw Base32 secret keys, JSON backup arrays, and encrypted vault payloads with secret key deduplication.

Standardized Warning Confirmation Popout: Replaced native browser confirm() dialogs and emojis with a unified popout modal featuring a Lucide warning triangle SVG icon for confirming unsaved account edits and account deletions.

Toast Notice Normalization: Fixed toast container to bottom-right viewport positioning with zero drop shadows, compact bounds, and single-listener registration to eliminate duplicate toasts on key copy or session actions.

Account Card & Form Interactions: Added a dedicated pen edit icon to account card headers, updated card body click targets to toggle code show/hide (reveals code if hidden, hides if already visible), and added inline pen edit buttons to account details fields to unlock inputs on demand.

title: UI & Aesthetic Overhaul, Settings & Modal Refinement
summary: Major frontend redesign featuring a clean developer-focused theme, standardized Settings & Account modals, responsive grid alignment, and topbar icon normalization.
changes: Settings Modal: Standardized toggle switch styling with solid white knobs (#ffffff), drop shadows, and vibrant green active tracks (#2da44e) that persist identically across light and dark modes.
Account Details Modal: Realigned inline form labels and inputs, zeroed top header padding, and transformed action buttons into right-aligned square SVG icons with subtle hover background tints.

Account Cards & Grid Layout: Added top grid alignment (align-items: start) to prevent card stretching on expansion, fixed immediate account pin re-rendering, and reorganized card body elements (timer under brand icon, centered OTP code, right-aligned copy button).

Top Bar & Action Navigation: Replaced text buttons with official Lucide vector SVG icons (Plus, Sync & Refresh, Settings) featuring custom optical scale normalization (1.12x for Plus, 0.95x for Settings) for uniform visual mass.
Header & Search Bar: Replaced glowing pseudo-elements with an uncolored inline SVG lock logo using dynamic stroke colors, and refined search bar focus states with crisp accent borders.
Design System & Theme: Replaced neon glows and floating gradients with a clean, developer-focused dark palette (#0d1117 background, #161b22 cards, #30363d borders, #2f81f7 blue accent).

title: Dynamic Component Rendering & Privacy Enhancement
summary: Improved application performance through external HTML fragment loading and updated session security model.
changes: Refactored modal dialog system to dynamically load HTML fragment templates on demand.
Upgraded session authorization and logging identifiers to use cryptographic discriminators.
Integrated real-time service health dashboard and status monitoring.

title: Encrypted Sync & Compressed Backups
summary: Added support for real-time peer-to-peer data sync and compressed vault storage.
changes: Implemented 4-digit PIN numeric handshake for secure device pairing.
Added support for compressed SQLite vault payload export and import.
Added client-side security event logging and audit history.

title: Initial Vault Authenticator Release
summary: Core launch of the Vault Authenticator progressive web app.
changes: TOTP and HOTP two-factor authentication code generation with visual timer countdowns.
Offline-first PWA architecture with local AES-GCM encrypted persistence.
Integrated camera QR code scanning and manual secret key registration.
